jobs.title: Customer Care Representative
jobs.description:
Your mission
 Do you love helping people and learning new things? If so, you might be the perfect fit for our Customer Care Representative position. You will be the main link between Yuh and our awesome clients, who use our app to manage their finances and investments. You will answer their questions, solve their problems, and guide them through their financial journey with Yuh.
 Key Responsabilities

• Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, handling of inbound and outbound phone calls (approximately 70–80% of daily activities), and delivering a consistently professional and positive customer experience.

• Provide accurate support via telephone, ensuring first class service quality. Resolving client inquiries, issues and requests related to the Yuh App in the sectors pay, save and investments.

• Actively guide and support clients, mainly over the phone, through their financial journey, explaining products, features and processes in a clear, empathetic, friendly and compliant manner.

• Ensure the highest levels of client satisfaction by executing client instructions and addressing concerns with friendliness and professionalism, especially in time sensitive or complex situations.

• Accurately document client interactions and outcomes in internal systems, ensuring proper follow-up and transparency across teams. Collaborate closely with other Customer Care Representatives and internal departments to ensure seamless service delivery and contribute insights for platform, service, and process improvements.

• Uphold the principles of fair client treatment, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance at all times.

• Completed apprenticeship (Federal certificate of Competence (Fähigkeitszeungnis / Fachausweis/ Berufsmatura)

• Previous experience in customer satisfaction, preferably in financial services in handling customer enquiries and complaints

• Fluency in English and French depending on your work location. For this position, Italian proficiency is highly recommended (German is a plus).

• A strong interest for financial product and markets, including stocks, ETFs and cryptocurrencies

• Excellent communication – verbal and written – skills

• Familiarity with office software and phone systems

• You are particularly skilled at listening, communicating, showing empathy, and being spersuasive

• You have a proactive and “can do” attitude

• You like working in a team

• Guidare attivamente e sostenere i clienti, soprattutto al telefono, attraverso il loro viaggio finanziario, spiegando prodotti, caratteristiche e processi in modo chiaro, empatico, amichevole e compiacente.

• Apprendistato completo (certificato federale di competenza (Fähigkeitszeungnis / Fachausweis/ Berufsmatura)
• Esperienza precedente nella soddisfazione del cliente, preferibilmente nei servizi finanziari nella gestione delle richieste e dei reclami dei clienti
• Fluency in inglese e francese a seconda della tua posizione di lavoro. Per questa posizione, la competenza italiana è altamente raccomandata (il tedesco è un plus).
• Un forte interesse per i prodotti e i mercati finanziari, tra cui azioni, ETF e criptovalute
• Ottima comunicazione – verbale e scritta – competenze
• Familiarità con software per ufficio e sistemi telefonici
• Siete particolarmente abili nell'ascolto, nella comunicazione, nell'empatia e nell'essere spersuasive
• Hai un atteggiamento proattivo e “può fare”
• Ti piace lavorare in una squadra

jobs.title: Head Trader eFX Spot – Associate-Director
jobs.description:
As an Associate-Director in the FX & DA Trading department, you will be in charge of the eFX Spot team. Reporting directly to the Head Spot Vice-Director, you will supervise the operational activities and manage people in accordance with your senior management.
 Key responsibilities
 Team Management:

• Leading and supporting the eFX Spot team:
• Fostering a positive work atmosphere where employees feel motivated, valued, and connected to the team and the organization.

• Promoting collaboration, trust, and cohesion among team members.

• Addressing any potential conflicts among team members to your senior management and/or HR Partner

• Supporting employee growth through training, mentorship, coaching, and advancement opportunities.

• Hiring:
• Leading the recruitment process with your Talent Acquisition Partner

• Ensuring new hires are properly introduced to the team, the organization, its culture, policies, and their specific roles.

• Performance Management: Setting performance expectations, providing feedback, conducting performance reviews, and addressing any performance issues.

• Conducting under performance process with the help of your Senior Management and HR Partner.
 Operational duties:

• Own the realized risk and PnL

• Ensure successful and compliant operations
• Monitor orders, trades, overall market conditions, news flow, real-time risk and PnL

• Fine-tune price construction, execution and risk management production systems

• Monitor the overall client activity and ensure flow quality, as well as smooth client trading experience

• Maintain a gainful network of hedging counterparties and market venues

• Analyze results, identify and drive improvements

• Data analysis: Use internal analytical tools and your own quantitative capabilities to draw data-driven conclusions, suggest actions, deliver reporting

• Documentation: maintain up-to-date operational procedures and ensure compliance

• Collaborating: Be a reference point for Sales, Software Engineers, IT colleagues and other internal teams

• Project Management: Contribute to product development and infrastructure improvements

• Monitoring: team’s capacity allocation

• Minimum 8 years’ experience in sell-side electronic FX trading

• Previous experience in a leadership role is a strong advantage

• Deep understanding of market (micro)structure

• Deep understanding of client needs (both retail and institutional segments) and the competition landscape

• Proficient in transforming large data sets into actionable insights

• Ability to prioritize and deliver multiple tasks in a deadline-driven environment

• Excellent interpersonal skills, results-oriented, team player

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

jobs.title: Senior Payroll Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Payroll & Compensation Specialist to own and manage our end-to-end payroll operations while contributing to the development of a robust compensation & benefits. This role combines operational excellence in payroll with a strategic mindset to improve processes and drive automation.
 Key Responsibilities :
 Payroll Management

• Manage the full monthly payroll cycle, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timeliness.

• Process payroll inputs, including variable elements, absences, and employee changes.

• Perform payroll controls and reconciliations.

• Handle payroll-related accounting entries, including monthly and annual closings in collaboration with finance.

• Ensure compliance with local labor laws, tax regulations, and social security requirements.

• Act as the main point of contact for payroll-related queries.

• Ensure supervision and validation of payroll processes with the abroad entities in collaboration with local HR partners and payroll providers.

• Ensure proper documentation and audit trail for all payroll activities.

Process Improvement & Automation

• Identify opportunities to improve payroll and HR processes.

• Drive automation initiatives to increase efficiency and reduce manual work.

• Document and standardize payroll and compensation processes.

• Collaborate with HRIS teams to optimize systems and workflows.

Compensation & Benefits

• Manage and calculate ad hoc compensation elements (bonuses, incentives, equity/participation plans, etc.).

• Contribute to salary benchmarking and market analysis.

• Help design and maintain salary grids and compensation structures.

• Partner with Talent Management on compensation reviews and cycles.

Budget & Reporting

• Monitor payroll and compensation budgets in collaboration with Finance.

• Prepare regular reports and dashboards (headcount, payroll costs, compensation analysis).

• Provide insights and recommendations to support decision-making.

Experience & Skills

• 5+ years of experience in payroll, ideally in an international or fast-paced environment.

• Strong knowledge of payroll processes, accounting principles, and compliance.

• Strong knowledge of Swiss payroll and Swiss labor laws & regulations.

• Genuine interest in Compensation & Benefits topics and a willingness to develop expertise in this area.

• Experience with payroll systems and HRIS.

• Solid analytical skills with strong attention to detail.

• Exposure to Compensation & Benefits topics (benchmarking, salary structures, bonus schemes) is a strong plus.
 Soft Skills

• High level of accuracy and reliability.

• Strong organizational and prioritization skills.

• Ability to work cross-functionally with HR, Finance, and external providers.

• Proactive mindset with a continuous improvement approach.

• Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex topics clearly.

Please note that Swissquote never requests sensitive personal information or payment of any kind during the recruitment process. Any such request is fraudulent.

Envie de découvrir une banque de l’intérieur et de vivre une expérience apprenante unique en Suisse ?

En nous rejoignant en tant qu’apprenti.e, tu embarques pour un voyage de 4 ans au sein des différentes équipes qui font de Swissquote, le leader de la banque en ligne en Suisse.
 Viens explorer notre univers en suivant un parcours de formation complet et varié. Guidé.e par un.e maître d’apprentissage, tu vas passer  plusieurs sessions de 6 à 9 mois au sein de différentes équipes au sein du Marketing pour apprendre leurs principaux métiers et réaliser des missions concrètes.
 Le métier de médiamaticien·ne allie créativité, technologies numériques, communication et gestion de projet. Tu travailleras dans un environnement dynamique au croisement de l’informatique, du design, du marketing et des médias.
 Durant ton apprentissage, tu auras l’occasion de passer dans les départements suivants, et tes tâches principales seront, entre autres :

• Project Management & Intégration  : support à la planification et suivi de projets, support à l’intégration dans le CMS et intégration d’emails, …

• Brand Management  : participer à la planification et à la mise en œuvre de campagnes marketing, suivi des promotions, analyse des résultats, …

• Social Media  : Collaborer à la gestion des réseaux sociaux, aider à la création de contenu, community management, …

• Internal Communication  : créer des communications internes, proposer et implémenter des améliorations pour l’intranet, …

• Digital marketing & SEO  : monitorer les performances des articles du blog, recommander de nouveaux articles et les illustrer, faire un suivi avec les créateurs de contenus, …

• Design  : création de contenus (graphisme, vidéo, audio, brochures, newsletters), comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs et concevoir des expériences pertinentes, …

• Web Development  : développement et gestion de sites web (apprendre à utiliser différents langages web tels HTML, CSS, PHP, JavaScript), …
 En complément de notre formation pratique, tu pourras également suivre les cours spécialisés et de culture générale de l’école professionnelle commerciale .

Et ce n’est pas tout ! Nous t’offrons également de super avantages, comme le demi-tarif payé ou des offres préférentielles pour le sport (fitness, escalade, football…).

En rejoignant Swisssquote, tu intégres plus qu’une entreprise mais un environnement de travail jeune (35 ans de moyenne d’âge), divers (70 nationalités différentes) et amical (pas de dress code obligatoire).
 Alors viens grandir avec nous !

• Tu viens de terminer ta scolarité obligatoire ?

• Tu parles français couramment et as de bonnes bases en anglais ?

• Tu as un intérêt marqué pour les technologies, la communication et le design ?

• Tu sais te montrer créatif, curieux et organisé ?

Tu réunis toutes ces qualités ? N’hésitez pas à postuler en ligne avec votre dossier complet :

- CV

- lettre de motivation

- bulletin de notes des trois dernières années.

Pourquoi ton apprentissage à Swissquote ?

• Formation diversifiée et complète dans le domaine bancaire

• Opportunité d’acquérir une expérience professionnelle dans une entreprise innovante, multiculturelle et en pleine expansion

• Partage et échange d'expériences avec notre communauté d’environ 25 apprenti.e.s en poste à Swissquote
